Before Check a row is default or selected only. After Check, the picked correct option is correct (green fill #14AE5C, leading check); a correct option the learner did not pick is correctUnselected (green outline #14AE5C, leading check, no solid green disc); a wrong option is wrong (fill #9B4F36, X). dim is graded chrome at opacity 0.4. disabled is a separate non-interactive state

default 默认: white, light border #C9B8B2, empty circle. selected 选中: selected fill #9B4F36 and a ring. correct 正确已选: green fill #14AE5C and a leading check. correctUnselected 正确未选: green outline #14AE5C and a leading check, no solid green disc. wrong 错误: fill #9B4F36 and an X. dim 变淡: graded chrome at opacity 0.4. #9B4F36 on selected and wrong is the selected fill, separate from the danger role of --ba-error. Aliases: idle is default, shown is correctUnselected
Visible row is the letter, the body, and the leading status icon. correct and correctUnselected use the leading check only. The accessible name carries the state
Border 1px solid
Hover scale 1.02 and pressed scale 0.95, the same scale as the BAButton CTA. Reduced motion updates state immediately and does not scale
Keep the focus ring on solid fills. A non-interactive option uses dim or the existing disabled treatment
